description: A fixed voltage to each of up to eight channels of a polyphonic output, one knob per channel

params.text: Sets the voltage carried by that polyphonic channel, ±10V until the menu changes the range

outputs.text: One polyphonic cable carrying every channel's knob voltage

notes: for putting deliberate variation across the channels of a poly voice
menu: Polyphony channels — the number of channels the output carries, Monophonic or 2 through 8
Range — sets the voltage span the knobs cover: +/-10V, +/-5V, +/-3V, +/-2V, +/-1V, 0V-10V, 0V-5V, 0V-3V, 0V-2V or 0V-1V
